question: The English word juggernaut comes from the name Jagannath, meaning ‘Lord of the World’. Where is the world-famous Shree Jagannath temple located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• By the end of the 11th Century A.D. and early 12th Century, the Ganga dynasty captured political power over Odisha.

 
 
• The first ruler of this dynasty, Ananta Varman Chodaganga Deva (1078- 1147) started the construction of the great Jagannath Temple at Puri. 
 
 
 
• The Ganga dynasty was succeeded by another glorious dynasty known as the Suryavamsi Gajapatis. 
 
• The first Gajapati King was Kapilendra Deva (1435-1466) who extended his empire by winning wars against the neighbouring powers.
 
 
• His son Purusottam Deva consolidated the empire.
 
• But during the rule of his successor Pratap Rudra Deva, the Gajapati dynasty and its kingdom Kalinga suffered a political and military decline.
 
 
 
• During the 8th and 9th centuries, a powerful dynasty known as the Bhaumakara dynasty ruled over the territories of Utkal.
 
 
• Bhaumakara dynasty was followed by the rule of Somvansi rulers.
 
 
 
• The Somavamshi dynasty ruled parts of present-day Odisha in eastern India between the 9th and the 12th centuries.
 
 
• Their capitals included Yayatinagara (modern Binka) and Abhinava-Yayatinagara (modern Jajpur).
